beam_volume.aperture(row) returns (jaws, leaves) for a modelled row: jaws maps 'x'/'y' to a (low, high) pair or None; leaves is None without an MLC, else (boundaries, x1, x2, opening) as numpy arrays, as _point builds today
beam_mu refuses with REASON_BEAM_VOLUME a plan whose MLCX leaf boundaries are not strictly increasing
Every pre-existing test in tests/test_beam_volume.py passes with no change to what it asserts, including test_beam_volume_catches_and_quiets_nothing
docs/specs/2026-11-11-beam-volumes.md 'Not modelled' list names non-increasing leaf boundaries

tasks.title: fluence module: fluence_mu(plan, rows) -> (float32 (beams, 400, 400) image, beam_numbers), exact-area apertures, REASON_FLUENCE
tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_fluence.py, unit-level, reusing tests/test_beam_volume.py's static()/set_mlc()/written()/ct_image() fixtures (import them) to build plans and rows. Geometry, grid, weighting, refusals exactly per the spec's Decisions and Refusals sections: collimator frame, pixel j covers [j-200, j-199] mm, exact area fraction with max(0, ...) overlaps, rectangles of non-positive size dropped before the off-grid check, aperture(row) on every row, off-grid check only for non-zero weight, strict +-200 mm, duplicate int(BeamNumber) among non-SETUP beams of plan['BeamSequence'] refused, float64 accumulation cast to float32. Hint: per control point build pairs x 400 Y- and X-overlap matrices and add w * Y.T @ X. AC14's test is marked slow (pytest -m slow) and builds the 2 arcs x 178 control point plan as test_beam_volume's slow test does; record wall time in findings.md. Import fixtures explicitly by name from test_beam_volume (static, set_mlc, written, ct_image, vmat_arc, _blocks, ...; pythonpath includes tests), never test_* names or *. fluence.py uses no beam_volume name other than aperture. fluence_mu returns beam_numbers as a list of ints; the ';'-join happens only in convert's _series_rows.
criteria: AC1: a static jaw-only field X [-50, 50], Y [-30, 30] mm, MU 100 gives shape (1, 400, 400) float32 via sitk.GetArrayFromImage, 100 (tolerance 1e-4) in fully-inside pixels, 0 in fully-outside pixels, origin (-199.5, -199.5, 0), spacing (1, 1, 1), identity direction

AC2: jaws X [10, 60], Y [-30, 30] light only columns >= 210; jaws Y [10, 40], X [-50, 50] light only rows >= 210; an MLCX whose only open pair is the highest-Y pair lights only rows inside that pair's boundaries; an open X2-side leaf opening at +X lights only X > 0 (vault: iec-61217-dicom-patient-position-beam-projection, one-sided fields)
AC3: one beam with the one-sided field jaws X [10, 60], Y [-30, 5] at (collimator, gantry, couch) = (0, 0, 0), (90, 0, 0) and (30, 270, 45) yields identical, non-zero maps
AC4: jaws X [-10.3, 20.7], Y [-5.25, 7.5], MU M give sum of pixels = M * 31.0 * 12.75 within 1e-3 relative, and an edge pixel holds M times its covered fraction

AC5: with leaf boundaries every 2.5 mm and 5 mm, sub-mm leaf ends, one closed pair (X1 = X2) and one crossed pair (X1 > X2), sum of pixels = sum over open pairs of MU * width * height clipped to the jaws; closed and crossed pairs add 0; a crossed jaw pair gives an all-zero slice; no pixel is negative

AC6: a two-segment step-and-shoot beam (MU a then b, different apertures) gives a where only segment 1 is open, b where only segment 2, a+b where both; a multi-control-point arc-like beam has sum of pixels = sum_i weight_i * open area_i with the half-segment weights

AC7 (module): a three-beam plan with BeamNumbers 7, 2, 5 in BeamSequence order and different one-sided apertures gives shape (3, 400, 400); slice k matches beam k in that order, and beam_numbers == [7, 2, 5]

AC8 (module): each not-modelled aperture case, an open edge at 200.01 mm, and duplicate BeamNumbers (including two adjacent beams sharing a number) raise CaseRefused(REASON_FLUENCE); an open edge at exactly 200 mm is accepted; a plan with a non-zero table-top angle, or a missing SAD, is accepted. Off-grid is checked on each pair's rectangle after jaw intersection and after dropping non-positive sizes: accepted are open leaves X1 = -250, X2 = +250 behind jaws X [-100, 100], a closed pair parked at X1 = X2 = -250, and outermost leaf boundaries beyond +-200 outside Y jaws [-100, 100]; refused is the same open pair with no X jaw. An aperture reaching 250 mm on a weight-0 control point is accepted; the same aperture with non-zero weight is refused
AC9: for _blocks, _mlc_not_mlcx, _null_boundaries, _no_y_limit and non-increasing leaf boundaries, both beam_volume.beam_mu and fluence.fluence_mu refuse

AC10: an AST test shows fluence.py raises only CaseRefused(REASON_FLUENCE), has no try/except and no quiet_call/_pydicom_quiet, and the only beam_volume name it uses is aperture; REASON_FLUENCE is a non-empty fixed string
AC14: the full-size synthetic VMAT plan (2 arcs x 178 control points, built with vmat_arc) produces its fluence map in under 10 s (slow test)

tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_convert.py with the existing photon-plan convert tests and their NOT_MODELLED table (~line 2062). FLUENCE_NAME = 'fluence_mu.nii.gz'; fluence_mu runs in its own try/except CaseRefused (log.warning('convert: %s', fluence.REASON_FLUENCE)) outside _header_call, after beam_mu and before case_dir.mkdir; written with write_atomic after beam_mu; _series_rows gains beam_numbers and appends the fluence row after beam only when FLUENCE_NAME in files. Update on purpose the exact file lists, row kinds and WARNING counts of the existing photon tests (spec Decisions 'Existing convert tests change on purpose'). NOT_MODELLED split (test_convert.py ~2049): blocks, mlcy, null-boundaries, unbounded-axis, two-conditions -> no fluence, 2 WARNINGs (drop the all-WARNINGs-are-beam_mu assertion for these only); no-sad, position-unsupported, position-absent -> fluence written, 1 WARNING. Optional: mirror test_a_bug_in_beam_mu_propagates for fluence. Build convert-level plans with plan_meta=dict(beams=[...]) as _beam_edit does (duplicate BeamNumbers = two photon_beam dicts with the same number; off-grid and TableTopPitchAngle by editing the beam dict); no tests/synthetic_dicom.py change is expected. The commit gate allows 5 files per commit: if a sixth file is unavoidable, commit the task in two parts.
criteria: A converted photon plan writes fluence_mu.nii.gz and a series.json row with kind 'fluence', modality 'RTPLAN', plan columns filled, frame_of_reference_uid = the plan's, after the beam row
That row's dicom equals the plan row's dicom plus a last key beam_numbers, the ';'-joined BeamNumbers in slice order (a plan numbered 7, 2, 5 gives '7;2;5')

Each NOT_MODELLED aperture case (blocks, mlcy, null-boundaries, unbounded-axis, two-conditions) writes no fluence_mu.nii.gz and no fluence row, logs exactly one REASON_FLUENCE WARNING (two WARNINGs in total with beam_mu's), and still writes plan.parquet; no-sad, position-unsupported and position-absent write fluence and log only beam_mu's WARNING

An off-grid plan (open edge at 200.01 mm) and a duplicate-BeamNumber plan each write plan.parquet and beam_mu.nii.gz but no fluence file or row, and log exactly one WARNING, REASON_FLUENCE. A plan whose beam_mu is refused for SAD, PatientPosition or a non-zero TableTopPitchAngle still gets fluence_mu.nii.gz and its row
AC13: assert_no_leak runs over the aperture, off-grid and duplicate fluence refusal cases with the patient identifiers and finds none
A plan with no plan rows (brachy) has no fluence file, no fluence row and no new log line
